title: Controlling Latent Diffusion Using Latent CLIP
role: A released CLIP that reads clean 64 by 64 SDXL-family latents directly; a candidate second sentence scorer beside NoisyCLIP, with no evidence on noisy latents
reads: A clean, unscaled 64 by 64 by 4 SDXL-family VAE latent, patched into a ViT-B image tower, with its own CLIP text tower and no timestep input
trained_on: 2.7B LAION-2B-en and COYO images VAE-encoded at 512 pixels with captions, contrastive loss, 34B samples; clean latents only, no noise levels
score_enters: Latent-CLIP similarity is a ReNO reward; its gradient updates the starting noise of 1-step SDXL-Turbo over 50 gradient steps through a finished latent, never an intermediate x_t
adding_scores: not addressed; the only sum is the weighted reward sum in the ReNO objective, with no validity condition
properties: Generated-image benchmarks after ReNO for counting, attribute binding, spatial relation, position and prompt match; size untested; no right-against-wrong test of the score itself
unseen: no: zero-shot ImageNet from class names, with no held-out concept test
headline: With a Latent-ViT-B/4-plus reward on 1-step SDXL-Turbo, GenEval mean is 0.62 against 0.54 with no reward and 0.62 for pixel CLIP ViT-g/14 (0 to 1, higher is better); T2I-CompBench spatial stays 0.24 against 0.24; ReNO takes 9.01 s against 11.70 s for same-size pixel CLIP
copy_or_avoid: Copy the direct latent input and the divide-by-0.13025 rule; add it to W2 as a separate read-only test with 2 by 2 pooling, and avoid using it as the push until it is shown to read noisy latents at steps 0 to 15 (inferred)
model: SDXL-Turbo at 512 pixels, SDXL VAE latent space
